refinements.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This image is the edit target: a game mage synergy icon, ivory solid silhouette, open flame/diamond crown with four-point star above a pointed staff handle. Keep exactly this subject, symmetry, flat warm cream #E9DFC6 palette, sharp flame tapers, negative-space star separation, clean edges, and true transparent background. Change only its proportions and stroke boldness for readability at 27 to 52 pixels: make the crown much broader (overall visible width at least 65 percent of overall visible height), the center star 3 times larger, the crown structure thick and substantial rather than spindly, shorten the handle to one third of total height and make the handle solid thick taper with no tiny internal diamond cutouts. Crown occupies upper two thirds. Keep recognizable arcane staff, not a healer cross or currency flame. One centered glyph on square canvas, longest visible dimension75 percent of canvas. Fully opaque monochrome fill with antialiased edges, no RGB noise, white speckles, texture, lighting, glow, border, badge, text, checkerboard, or background. Only the symbol on alpha.
